description: This file defines an interface called AesStreamInterface in the Aws\Crypto namespace, which extends the StreamInterface. It specifies methods related to AES encryption streams, including getting OpenSSL-compatible names, AES-specific names, and Initialization Vector (IV) data.

classes.name: AesStreamInterface
classes.description: An interface for AES encryption streams that extends the PSR StreamInterface, providing methods to retrieve cryptographic identifiers and IV.

methods.name: getOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns a string identifier compatible with `openssl_*` functions, such as 'aes-256-cbc'.

methods.name: getAesName
methods.description: Returns an AES-specific name, such as 'AES/GCM/NoPadding'.

methods.name: getCurrentIv
methods.description: Provides the current Initialization Vector (IV) used for encrypting or decrypting the next block.
